caption: The drawing features two objects: on the left side, there is a hand-sewed bucket rendered in beige and yellow tones, with a rounded handle attached to the rim and a large yellow number "1" on its side beneath a yellow banner. On the right side, there is a fireman's top hat, colored primarily in shades of purple with a yellow and orange decorative motif resembling a fan or sunburst on one side. Below and to the right of the objects, there are handwritten descriptive labels: the words "Hand sewed bucket used about the year 1800 Lent by the Insurance Co. of North America, Philadelphia, Pa." are written below the bucket, and "Fireman's top hat" is written next to the hat, with an arrow pointing to it. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Fireman's Hat and Bucket
